label: KSafe
description: Karoo safety extension on two layers: REACTIVE (crash detection, SOS, check-in, HR-based medical episode and wellness detection) and PREVENTIVE (carb and hydration tracking that adapts to your effort using the Karoo's HR and power zones, reminding you to fuel before bonking or dehydration impairs your judgment on the bike). Sends emergency alerts via WhatsApp (CallMeBot), Telegram, Pushover or ntfy.
releaseNotes: Fewer false crash alerts when you stop and stand with the bike upright after a hard bump (pothole). Since 2.2.2: crash and heart-rate detection recover if a Karoo data stream stops mid-ride; fewer false crash alerts when GPS briefly freezes or when you lean the bike after a bump; less battery (only the sensors your features need); option to turn off the ride-start warning (Provider tab). Fueling: no reminder right after you log a drink or food, and a timed reminder no longer arrives just before an "Eat now — behind" or "Drink now — behind" alert — you get one alert instead of two.
